checks.name: 48_samples_to_odd_columns
checks.detail: 48 tubes -> 48 wells, odd columns only: True

checks.name: step_order
checks.detail: expected per well: beads > isopropanol > sample > remove > ethanol > remove > ethanol > remove > elution > recover

checks.name: fresh_tip_per_sample_no_cross_contact
checks.detail: 48 distinct tips for 48 sample transfers; violations: []

items.evidence: apiLevel 2.13, all volumes within pipette ranges (multi chunks ≤200 µL, p1000 250 µL), wells within capacity, reservoir draws within 15 mL per measured check.
Check fresh_tip_per_sample_no_cross_contact passed with 48 distinct tips; every tip is dropped and a fresh tip is used per column or per sample.
No mixing after elution buffer addition, and only 500 µL of the 540 µL supernatant is removed, leaving about 40 µL. Both are deviations or additions, and this item is all-or-nothing.
Check 48_samples_to_odd_columns passed. sample_routes pairs each tube with its own well in columns 1,3,5,7,9,11, and each eluate goes to a distinct elution well.
Beads 40, isopropanol 250, then sample 250 µL, mixed 5x, 5 min delay, magnet engaged with a 4 min delay, then removal to the waste plate with the magnet on. The measured checks all passed.
Two 500 µL ethanol washes, each added and removed with the magnet engaged. Then a 4 min delay before magdeck.disengage(). Checks two_500ul_ethanol_washes and air_dry_4min passed.

Elution buffer is dispensed with the magnet off but never mixed. There is only a 30 s delay, then the magnet is engaged, so the rubric's 'added off-magnet and mixed' is not met, although recovery of 100 µL to distinct wells is fine.

judge.summary: The protocol passes all 17 measured checks. Sample placement, binding, washes and drying, tip handling and recovery to distinct elution wells are correct. It fails elution_recovery because the elution buffer is never mixed. It fails fidelity_to_paper because that mixing is missing and about 40 µL of supernatant is left behind at each removal.
